item.title: Hilt found guilty on three charges in Bates County Circuit Court
item.description: At the Bates County Courthouse, a jury on Monday found Dallas Hilt guilty on three separate counts stemming from a June 2022 traffic stop. Hilt was charged in June of 2022 with driving while intoxicated, careless and imprudent driving, and operating a motor vehicle without a valid driver’s license. Assistant Prosecutor Cody Johnson represented the State. Hilt chose to represent himself at Tuesday’s proceedings. The jury deliberated for almost an hour before returning the guilty verdict. item.title: Important info from Bates County Clerk, Jami Page
item.description: The Bates County Commission approved and signed Resolution No. 26-001 that will put a property tax credit question on the April ballot.
